findings.title: «agent» instead of glossary «tác nhân»

findings.title: thread/reaction terms differ from Team Bridge
findings.note: Shipped vi uses «luồng» for thread (ui.teamBridge.replies.*: «Trả lời trong luồng», «Luồng trò chuyện», «Đóng luồng trò chuyện») and «cảm xúc» for reaction (ui.teamBridge.reactions.add «Thêm cảm xúc»). This file uses «chuỗi», which in shipped vi means a text 'string' (all 9 uses), and «biểu cảm». Suggested values are the Team Bridge twins.

Mechanical checks at aeecfe4a: key set and order equal English (172); every value parses with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and has the same argument names/types as English; plural arms present for the locale's CLDR categories; U+2026 ellipsis, never ASCII '...'; no bidi control characters; product names (Radient, Radient Console, Team Bridge, Local Operator Community) and #general byte-intact. All 12 suggested values were parsed the same way. Rendered fit and RTL layout not verified (no browser tool in this lane).

Accepted after reading all 172 values: bạn register, pronoun dropped where natural; other-only plurals; NFC throughout; «Cộng đồng» / «Tổ chức» kept distinct; «người kiểm duyệt» / «bộ kiểm duyệt» match shipped ui.teamBridge.delivery.refused.
